headline: Use a short booth visit to qualify Ailytics, Ajentik and Fano; extend only for a concrete hiring conversation.
positioning: AI/backend engineer who can ship and operate useful systems: Python/FastAPI, data ingestion, AWS deployments, agent retrieval/tools and safe failure handling. Lead with production engineering before awards or broad AI enthusiasm.

basis.availability: Immediate, confirmed 18 October; MTech completion August 2027
basis.judgement: Ranks are editorial judgements about technical fit, vacancy evidence and scarce event time. They are not sponsorship probabilities.

targets.why: Closest technical match: retrieval, tools, agents, evaluation and reliable healthcare workflows. The actual internship description asks for Python/JavaScript, agent frameworks, coding-agent use and debugging.
targets.lead_with: ResearchAgent + TalkToIt; demonstrate bounded tool use, grounded answers, failure recovery and private health-data processing.
targets.tradeoff: GPA 4.0/5 or equivalent is specified; your eligibility is not confirmed. Intern title/body differ, and compensation/duration are unstated. Rezonate is talk-only in the briefing. Its 11:30 talk is the only published event location; no early interview or hiring contact is confirmed. Do not wait solely for a generic presentation.

targets.tradeoff: The junior job includes on-site hardware, IP cameras and practical networking, not just AWS. The internship is primarily data collection/labelling; backend engineer requires three professional Python/Django years, beyond your saved one-year Python experience.

targets.tradeoff: Substantial presales, demos, decks, requirements and proposals. It is a stronger solution-engineering opening than a guaranteed software-development internship. Do not infer a Chinese requirement from multilingual products.

ep.headline: Qualify the role, employing entity and salary band — not the company’s nationality.
ep.note: No priority vacancy checked explicitly confirms Singapore EP sponsorship. Singapore-headquartered product companies can still be worthwhile; an international employer is not automatically willing to sponsor. Public-sector or citizen/PR-only programmes receive less of your limited event time.
ep.question: I’m on a Student Pass and my placement is non-credit-bearing. Can your team host that internship, and for a suitable full-time role do you sponsor EP applications? Who can confirm this for the actual employing entity?
ep.salary: Your saved expectation is SGD 5,000/month, with base versus total unspecified. MOM’s current lowest EP qualifying salary is SGD 5,600 outside financial services; new applications from 1 January 2027 start at SGD 6,000. Thresholds rise with age and differ for financial services. Do not anchor a future EP conversation at SGD 5,000; ask HR for the applicable salary band and eligibility assessment. This does not change your saved expectation.
ep.internship_note: Ask HR to confirm the internship’s applicable work-pass/school route separately. Neither immediate availability nor a future EP discussion establishes internship work permission.

backups.use: Only if time remains and a technical opening is offered
backups.reason: Industrial data, sensors and deployment offer a good Primech/BugRaid discussion. Official careers route checked; no matching Singapore vacancy verified. Qualify the actual employing team and internship opening in a short conversation.

backups.use: Level 3 backup if a core booth is inaccessible
backups.reason: Global logistics and data workflows fit, but no current matching Express technical vacancy verified. Do not transfer another DHL division’s internship conditions to Express.

backups.use: Level 4 backup if a concrete software project is offered
backups.reason: Fitback and TalkToIt align with imaging/health software. Only a career-enquiry route verified; ask about supervision, working language and sponsorship rather than assuming them.

deprioritised.reason: Excluded at your request; do not use its 10:00 talk.
Lower event priority under your private/international-employer preference, with weak verified junior matches. No blanket citizens-only or no-EP policy was established.
Its published 2026 MAP is closed and citizen/PR-only. No separate live technical internship was verified. This programme restriction does not describe every Singlife job.
AWS Career Launchpad is citizen/PR-only; direct internal software hiring is separate and unverified. Its 11:30 talk conflicts with the stronger Rezonate session.
No verified matching engineering internship; less direct coding evidence or a less useful allocation of scarce booth/talk time. They are not declared ineligible employers.

strategies.title: Treat the morning as a short qualification visit
strategies.text: Start with the three core booths and a 10:15–10:20 exit decision. Extend only for a specific hiring conversation or a confirmed attendance obligation. Lunch and passport completion are not recruitment goals.

strategies.title: Use a 90-second qualification loop
strategies.text: Give a 20-second technical introduction, ask what an intern would build, then ask about non-credit placement and EP support. If the answer is no sponsorship, mandatory credit or no engineering opening, record it and move on politely.

strategies.title: Show one relevant proof, not a tour of everything
strategies.text: Prepare a 60-second demo or a few local screenshots for ResearchAgent and TalkToIt, and a concise BugRaid deployment story. Use synthetic/demo data. Have the correct company-specific CV ready for the later submission route.

strategies.title: Ask for an owned deliverable
strategies.text: Ask what you could ship in the first four to six weeks, who reviews the code, and how success is evaluated. At Fano and SAP Fioneer, specifically ask how much is implementation versus presales or documentation.

strategies.title: Leave with a named next step
strategies.text: Capture one person/team, an exact role or ITS project, a submission route and a deadline. Ask whether mentioning the booth conversation in your later application is appropriate; do not assume a referral was offered.

strategies.title: Follow up while the details are fresh
strategies.text: After the event, check ITS, shortlist the roles whose eligibility is confirmed, and adapt your follow-up to a specific project discussed. The briefing says CV submission and interviews happen afterward.

full_morning_plan.title: Register and check signage
full_morning_plan.detail: Collect the physical Talent Passport. Confirm today’s rooms and any programme changes.

full_morning_plan.title: Ailytics
full_morning_plan.detail: Lead with BugRaid deployments and Primech IoT. Qualify junior DevOps, networking expectations, non-credit placement and EP support.

full_morning_plan.title: Ajentik AI
full_morning_plan.detail: Ask about a funded AI/backend internship with one owned deliverable. Use TalkToIt and ResearchAgent; clarify sponsorship early.

full_morning_plan.title: Move to Beacon
full_morning_plan.detail: Allow the floor change; if a queue has delayed you, leave with a contact instead of missing the talk.

full_morning_plan.title: SAP Fioneer sharing session
full_morning_plan.detail: First presentation sticker. Ask which project is genuinely engineering-led, and whether the verified BA internship offers technical implementation.

full_morning_plan.title: Fano Labs
full_morning_plan.detail: Discuss the four-month late-October intake. Ask how much is coding/POC evaluation versus presales, then confirm work-pass support.

full_morning_plan.title: Keysight
full_morning_plan.detail: Ask about EDA requisition 54397, the electronics learning gap and any successor software/AI automation roles. Do not use expired 54365 as an active lead.

full_morning_plan.title: Yokogawa · fifth booth / backup
full_morning_plan.detail: A short qualification conversation on industrial software/data projects. If no suitable opening or sponsor route, end early. Five planned booths now complete.

full_morning_plan.title: Buffer and move to Inspire
full_morning_plan.detail: Save notes and prepare the Rezonate question. Use only spare time for follow-up; avoid starting another talk.

full_morning_plan.title: Rezonate sharing session
full_morning_plan.detail: Protect this session. Ask about the engineering internship’s GPA gate, paid scope and EP path during Q&A; request a named technical follow-up if possible. Second presentation sticker.

full_morning_plan.title: Brief speaker follow-up if available
full_morning_plan.detail: Ask permission for a short conversation; if the speaker is busy, take the team’s submission route. Do not assume a formal interview will happen today.

full_morning_plan.title: Lunch and shortlist
full_morning_plan.detail: Use the physical passport for lunch. Export notes, check ITS and prioritise the leads with confirmed placement and sponsorship pathways.

attendance.verdict: No advertised walk-in interview or on-site screening programme was found. The student briefing places CV submission and internship interviews after the event, with ITS instructions and later shortlisting.
attendance.scope: Online applications are part of the later route; the interview format itself is not specified. Do not assume all interviews are online or that informal conversations at booths are formal interviews.

confirmed.title: Beginning
confirmed.text: 09:00–09:30 is registration. No separate opening plenary is listed. Booth engagement starts at 09:30.

confirmed.title: Lunch
confirmed.text: Lunch redemption starts at 12:10 at Cove of Excellence, Level 1. No recruiting or interview activity is described for lunch.

confirmed.title: Applications and interviews
confirmed.text: The briefing says CV submission and internship interviews happen after TalentXperience. Check ITS for CV instructions; shortlisted students receive later invitations.

confirmed.title: Employer application pages
confirmed.text: Several target roles already have public online application routes. No event-only application link or guaranteed fast-track was found; ask which route applies to the specific project.

attendance.unresolved: The briefing says choose at least two sessions. It does not say whether this is an academic attendance requirement or only an event/passport expectation. The registration form is closed and exposes no additional rule. Ask staff once at check-in about compulsory attendance and early departure before following a shortened visit.
attendance.organiser_question: Is full attendance or the two-talk instruction compulsory for my programme, or is it only the passport/lunch challenge? Which company representatives here can shortlist engineering candidates? Is Rezonate’s engineering or hiring representative available before 11:30?
attendance.interview_ask: I’m interested in this specific engineering role. If my non-credit placement and work-pass situation fit, could we arrange a 15-minute technical conversation next week, or could you introduce me to the person who shortlists? I’ll follow the required ITS or employer application route.

green_signals.title: A real, funded role
green_signals.text: They name an actual internship or junior requisition, its intake and deliverable, and a supervisor or hiring team.

green_signals.title: Someone who can act
green_signals.text: The representative can review fit, introduce the hiring manager, or identifies the person who owns shortlisting.

green_signals.title: Your constraints are understood
green_signals.text: They explicitly address non-credit placement and the applicable work-pass route; for full-time hiring, an identified HR person can confirm EP support and salary band. Ask whether this is the formal school internship project or a separate non-credit opening.

green_signals.title: A specific next step
green_signals.text: A booked screen, a named introduction, an agreed CV review or a specific project/application deadline. These are signals of progress, not promises of an interview.

low_signals: Only a QR code or a generic careers-page link, with no project, team or useful eligibility answer.
A broad company deck or generic AI talk with nobody available to discuss the actual role.
An unstaffed booth, unclear hiring authority, or an unpaid/unfunded proposal with no defined engineering deliverable.
A mandatory credit-bearing or citizen/PR-only route, or explicit inability to support the required work-pass arrangement.
attendance.exit_rule: At about 10:15, leave once the three core conversations are complete and you have the available next steps. By about 10:20, leave unless a relevant hiring person has agreed to a specific near-term conversation or staff confirm an attendance obligation. Do not add booths or talks just to earn lunch.
attendance.rezonate_tradeoff: The briefing lists Rezonate only at the 11:30–12:00 Inspire talk, with no booth. Ask staff for an earlier introduction; there is no confirmed early availability. Do not wait an extra hour solely for a presentation. Extend for a confirmed hiring contact or if you deliberately choose to investigate this strongest-fit role.
attendance.late_option: If late entry is permitted and Rezonate is your main objective, an alternative is a roughly 10:45–12:00 window: two short booth conversations, then its 11:30 talk and a requested hiring follow-up. Booth representative availability and an after-talk conversation are not guaranteed.
skip: Lunch from 12:10, unless you want lunch or a relevant person has specifically agreed to meet then.
Singlife and Julius Baer talks; generic sessions whose role or placement does not fit.
The SAP Fioneer talk if its team gives you the needed role and eligibility information at the booth, subject to any compulsory-session rule.
Extra booths and sticker collection after you have qualified the relevant leads.
